steps.instructions: Read and analyze incoming emails
Generate appropriate email responses
Load and clean data from various sources
Perform statistical analysis and create visualizations
Generate comprehensive analysis report
Plan and organize workflow steps
Execute individual tasks in sequence

name: Organizational Intelligence Analyst
description: Analyzes any company website to create detailed organizational intelligence reports. Adapts analysis approach based on discovered industry and business model characteristics.
persona: Strategic business analyst with expertise in cross-industry organizational analysis. Skilled at identifying patterns and adapting methodologies to any business type or industry.

capabilities.name: adaptive_website_analysis
capabilities.description: Analyze any company website and automatically adapt analysis depth based on discovered business characteristics

steps.instructions: Use analysis_api with action 'analyze_website' to analyze the provided website URL. The tool will automatically identify the industry and business model, then provide appropriate analysis depth. Extract all available data: business_model, industry, company_size_estimate, primary_services, target_audience, organizational_complexity, inferred_processes, suggested_measurements with confidence scoring.

Transform the analysis into a structured organizational intelligence report. Use this adaptable format: {'website_analysis': {discovered_characteristics}, 'business_classification': {industry_specific_insights}, 'key_insights': {tailored_processes_and_measurements}, 'confidence_assessment': {analysis_reliability}, 'implementation_recommendations': {next_steps_based_on_company_type}}. Adapt the depth and focus areas based on the discovered industry and business model.

capabilities.name: dynamic_industry_benchmarking
capabilities.description: Create industry benchmark analysis for any discovered industry type with appropriate depth and focus

steps.instructions: Use analysis_api with action 'analyze_industry_benchmarks' to get comprehensive benchmarks. Pass the discovered industry information from previous analysis. The tool will adapt to provide relevant benchmarks for any industry type: industry_trends, typical_processes, key_performance_indicators, common_challenges, improvement_opportunities, benchmark_metrics, competitive_factors, regulatory_considerations, technology_trends.

Create an industry-adaptive benchmark report. Structure: {'industry_overview': {context_specific_trends}, 'performance_benchmarks': {relevant_metrics_for_this_industry}, 'process_standards': {industry_appropriate_workflows}, 'implementation_guidance': {tailored_priorities_and_timeline}}. Adjust the focus and depth based on the specific industry characteristics and company maturity level discovered in the analysis.

name: Adaptive Measurement Framework Architect
description: Designs measurement frameworks for any type of organization by analyzing their specific context and automatically adapting the approach. Creates frameworks that map to OrganizationAnalysisCapabilities structure regardless of industry.
persona: Expert measurement specialist with cross-industry experience. Skilled at identifying universal measurement patterns while adapting to specific business contexts, regulatory requirements, and operational characteristics.

capabilities.name: context_adaptive_framework_design
capabilities.description: Analyze organizational context and create tailored measurement framework that adapts to any business type

steps.instructions: Use kpi_api with action 'design_kpi_framework' to create a context-appropriate KPI framework. Pass the organizational context (industry, company_size, business_model) provided in the task. The tool will automatically adapt to provide relevant KPIs for any business type. Focus on getting 5-8 high-impact KPIs with complete definitions including name, category, thresholds{excellent, good, warning, critical}, calculationFrequency, dependentMeasurements[], and priority level suitable for the specific organizational context.

Transform the context-specific KPI framework into the standard OrganizationAnalysisCapabilities.measurementFramework format. Create structured output: {'measurementFramework': {'measurements': [], 'kpiDefinitions': [], 'reportingSchedule': {}, 'defaultValidationRules': []}}. Ensure each KPI includes all required fields: id, name, description, formula, dependentMeasurements[], calculationAgent (AgentId), calculationFrequency, targetValue, thresholds{excellent, good, warning, critical}. Adapt the validation rules and reporting schedule to match the organizational context and industry requirements.

capabilities.name: universal_measurement_creation
capabilities.description: Create measurement definitions that work for any business context with appropriate data sources

steps.instructions: Use measurement_api with action 'suggest_measurements_for_industry' to create measurement definitions appropriate for the organizational context. Pass the industry_type and processes[] from the task context. The tool will adapt to suggest relevant measurements for any business type, each containing: id, name, description, category (MeasurementCategory), measurementType ('raw_data'|'calculated_kpi'|'aggregated_metric'), dataSource{type, location, queryInstructions}, frequency (CalculationFrequency), assignedAgents[], validationRules[], alertThresholds{warning, critical}.

Create a comprehensive measurement system that integrates measurements with KPIs for any organizational context. Output format: {'measurementDefinitions': [], 'kpi_measurement_mapping': {}, 'data_collection_schedule': {}, 'validation_framework': {}}. Ensure measurements have appropriate dataSource configurations for the specific business type, establish proper KPI calculation chains, and create validation rules that match industry standards or general business practices. Adapt the system architecture to organizational size and complexity.

name: Process Architecture Specialist
description: Creates detailed business process definitions with monitoring points and improvement recommendations that map to OrganizationAnalysisCapabilities.processDefinitions structure
persona: Expert process analyst who designs comprehensive process architectures with detailed steps, monitoring points, and automation opportunities

capabilities.name: comprehensive_process_estimation
capabilities.description: Estimate detailed business processes matching OrganizationAnalysisCapabilities.processDefinitions structure

steps.instructions: Use analysis_api with action 'estimate_processes' to create comprehensive process definitions. Required input: industry_data{industry, company_size, business_model}. Expected output: estimated_processes[] with each containing: id, name, description, category, priority, estimated_complexity, steps[], monitoring_requirements[], automation_opportunities[], related_measurements[]. Focus on 3-5 core business processes with detailed step breakdown including estimatedDuration, requiredInputs[], expectedOutputs[], qualityChecks[].

Transform estimated processes into OrganizationAnalysisCapabilities.processDefinitions format. Create structured output: {'processDefinitions': [], 'monitoringPoints': [], 'improvementOpportunities': []}. Each ProcessDefinition must include: id, name, description, processSteps[], monitoringPoints[], assignedTeams[], monitoringAgents[], improvementTriggers[], relatedMeasurements[]. Each ProcessStep needs: id, name, description, estimatedDuration (minutes), requiredInputs[], expectedOutputs[], qualityChecks[], order. Create MonitoringPoint entries: id, stepId, metricName, collectionInstruction, alertThreshold, frequency.

capabilities.name: process_improvement_analysis
capabilities.description: Analyze existing processes and create detailed improvement recommendations

steps.instructions: Use analysis_api with action 'recommend_improvement_areas' to analyze process performance. Required input: process_data{processes[], performance_metrics{}}. Expected output: recommendations[] with each containing: process_name, improvement_type ('automation'|'optimization'|'quality'), title, description, priority ('high'|'medium'|'low'), estimated_impact, estimated_effort, success_metrics[], implementation_steps[]. Focus on actionable improvements with ROI estimates and implementation timelines.

Create detailed improvement roadmap matching OrganizationAnalysisCapabilities.improvementTracking format. Output structure: {'improvementAreas': [], 'implementation_roadmap': {}, 'success_metrics': {}}. Each ImprovementArea needs: id, name, description, priority, identifiedDate, status, assignedTeams[], estimatedImpact, resourcesRequired[], targetCompletion. Sort by priority and impact. Include implementation phases and success criteria.

name: Analysis Coordination Scheduler
description: Creates comprehensive analysis schedules and coordination systems that map to OrganizationAnalysisCapabilities.analysisSchedule structure
persona: Expert coordination specialist who designs efficient analysis workflows, reporting schedules, and automation systems with detailed implementation plans

capabilities.name: comprehensive_schedule_optimization
capabilities.description: Create detailed analysis schedules matching OrganizationAnalysisCapabilities.analysisSchedule structure

steps.instructions: Use analysis_api with action 'optimize_reporting_schedule' to create comprehensive schedules. Required input: analysis_context{measurements[], stakeholders[], organization_size}. Expected output: optimized_schedule{daily_reports{time, recipients[], content[], format, delivery}, weekly_reports{day, time, recipients[], content[], format, delivery}, monthly_reports{day, time, recipients[], content[], format, delivery}}, optimization_notes[], estimated_time_savings. Focus on balancing stakeholder needs with operational efficiency.

Transform optimized schedule into OrganizationAnalysisCapabilities.analysisSchedule format. Create structured output: {'analysisSchedule': {'timezone': 'UTC', 'dailyCollectionTime': '09:00', 'weeklyReportDay': 'monday', 'monthlyReportDay': 1, 'quarterlyReportMonth': 1, 'reporting': {'frequency': 'daily'|'weekly'|'monthly', 'recipients': [], 'format': 'dashboard'|'email'|'pdf', 'includeRecommendations': true}}}. Include detailed scheduling rationale and efficiency metrics.

capabilities.name: trend_analysis_and_insights
capabilities.description: Analyze performance trends and setup continuous monitoring systems

steps.instructions: Use kpi_api with action 'analyze_kpi_trends' to assess performance patterns. Required input: organization_id, filters{}. Expected output: trends[]{kpi_id, kpi_name, direction ('improving'|'declining'|'stable'), change_value, change_percentage, current_status, calculations_analyzed}, insights[], analysis_summary{total_kpis_analyzed, improving, declining, stable}. Focus on actionable insights and performance patterns.

Create comprehensive monitoring and alerting framework. Output structure: {'continuous_monitoring': {'trend_detection': {}, 'anomaly_alerts': {}, 'performance_insights': {}}, 'automation_recommendations': [], 'stakeholder_notifications': {}}. Include specific alert thresholds, escalation procedures, and automated insight generation. Map to improvement tracking systems for closed-loop optimization.

Generate professional aged care placement report with recommendations, facility matching, and care level assessment based on approved DRCare template structure
Format the report according to DRCare standards with proper sections: Executive Summary, Client Profile, Care Assessment, Facility Recommendations, Implementation Plan
Save the generated aged care placement report to the filesystem with proper naming convention and client organization

Develop comprehensive life plan including healthcare pathways, financial strategies, accommodation options, and care progression stages
Create structured life plan document with sections: Current Situation, Future Projections, Healthcare Pathway, Financial Planning, Accommodation Strategy, Implementation Timeline
Save the generated life plan report to the filesystem with proper naming convention and client organization

capabilities.name: executive_summary_report

Create concise executive summary highlighting critical points, immediate actions required, and strategic recommendations for decision makers
Format executive summary with professional presentation: Key Points, Critical Decisions, Immediate Actions, Strategic Recommendations, Next Steps
Save the generated executive summary to the filesystem with proper naming convention and client organization
